Claims Journal, January 6, 2010 (the date in its address; the page shows none): 'In Arkansas, Gov. Mike Beebe declared 27 counties as disaster areas after a deluge of rain swamped the state during Christmas.' It names Bradley, Calhoun, Clark, Clay, Cleburne, Cleveland, Craighead, Dallas, Drew, Faulkner, Grant, Greene, Hempstead, Jackson, Lafayette, Lincoln, Lonoke, Miller, Monroe, Nevada, Ouachita, Poinsett, Prairie, Pulaski, Saline, White and Woodruff counties, and quotes the National Weather Service: 'some areas in Arkansas received more than 8 inches of rain from Dec. 22 to Dec. 25.' The report gives no signing day, so the row carries the date of the report.
